title: 第九章：魔鬼的孩子
content_zh:
塞人部族因为胆小，历来喜欢靠近回纥王帐驻扎，所以，有外敌的时候，塞人部族就很有安全感，如果，有了内鬼，塞人就倒霉了。
羯斯噶是这个族群里少有的聪明人，面临这种大变革的时候，还知道跑过来暗示一下，看起来他真的很爱塞来玛跟娜哈。
也是云初在回纥部族里第一次发现还有男人会把女人的生死存亡看的比自己的命都重要。
要知道，一旦比粟特勤知道他泄露了自己的计划，他的下场一定会非常的凄惨，砍头在这种下场面前都是最轻的。
因为关系到羯斯噶的命，云初不得不非常的小心，准备好了所有捕捉旱獭的工具，就带着欢天喜地的娜哈跟一脸无奈的塞来玛去了草蜢湖。
从头到尾，他都没有告诉塞来玛自己为什么会带着她们母女在这个并不适合捕捉旱獭的时候来到草蜢湖。
天黑之前，他们三人就来到了草蜢湖，这里距离部族营地不过一千多米的距离，而且地势还高，如果今晚真的有什么事情，他们一家三口应该能看的见。
塞来玛见云初没有去放捕捉旱獭的绳网，而是开始在岩石边上搭建简易的房子，她就知道事情不怎么对。
想要问云初，想到云初才是这个家的主人，就闭上了嘴巴，跟娜哈一起捡拾周围的枯枝，准备晚上引火用。
云初搭建房子的地方选的很好，是在三块巨石中间，只要在顶上加盖一些树枝，就能很好的掩盖火光。
搭建好房子，云初就带着一根木叉去了湖边。
回纥人不吃鱼！
他们不吃鱼不是因为有什么禁忌，而是根本就不会处理鱼！
草蜢湖里有很多很多鱼，一点都不怕人，所以，云初轻易地用木叉就捉到条鱼。
这里的湖水温度偏冷，生长着一种冷水扁嘴鱼，很容易长十斤，在草蜢湖里，大鱼非常的凶勐，喜欢吃小鱼，所以，小鱼为了躲避大鱼就躲到了浅水处，正好便宜了云初以及塞来玛跟娜哈。
他们三个大概是整个回纥部落中唯一懂得如何吃鱼，以及怎么烹调这种鱼的人。
娜哈年纪这么小，却能长得如此胖，跟吃这种鱼有着很大很大的关系。
扁嘴鱼是一种高山冷水湖里的细鳞鱼，用刀子开一个口子，去掉内脏跟鳃，在捏着鱼皮用力一撕，就把整条鱼的鱼皮都给剥下来了，找一个木棍串起来，撒上盐巴，就可以放在一边腌制了。
一匹毛色斑驳的老狼从湖边巡梭一阵之后，就很自然的来到云初他们的火堆边上卧下来，用黄褐色的眼睛瞅着忙碌的云初，宛若一条老狗。
“老王！”娜哈欢呼一声就扑到老狼身边去了，将肥硕的身体骑在老狼的背上，捏着老狼的耳朵屁股一顿一顿的做骑马状。

老狼张大了嘴巴不断地向娜哈假作撕咬，娜哈却一点都不怕，还把手伸进狼嘴里抓人家的舌头。
塞来玛一点都不担心，忙着给小房子里铺设羊皮，云初更是对这一人一狼视若无物，忙着剥鱼皮。
如果不是因为云初嫌弃放羊的时候太寂寞，太无聊，这头被狼群驱逐出来的老孤狼早就死掉了。
也就是因为有这头老狼，云初才会在晚上带着塞来玛跟娜哈离开部族营地，来草蜢湖边宿营。
云初在天山有不少的好朋友，只不过，这些好朋友都是野兽，这也是没办法的事情，谁让他跟回纥人相处的时间越长，就越是喜欢跟野**朋友。
他有旱獭朋友，有狼朋友，有羊朋友，甚至还有一匹老的快要走不动路的马朋友，就是没有一个回纥朋友。
老狼吃完了带着鱼鳞的鱼皮，就把目光放在被篝火烤的吱吱作响的烤鱼上。
扁嘴鱼的鱼刺不少，云初一直在给娜哈剥鱼吃，她吃的很香，很贪婪，塞来玛却似乎没有什么胃口，有一口没一口的咬着鱼。
“羯斯噶应该不会出事。”
云初在喂饱了娜哈之后，也拿了一条鱼慢慢的吃。
塞来玛避开云初目光，瞅着继续跟老狼一起玩耍的娜哈道： “你从来就不是塞人，更不是回纥人，你跟我们所有人都不一样，云初，你是唐人。
只有唐人才会有那么多的规矩，也只有唐人才会把我这个养育你的女人真正当成母亲。
尽管我养育了你十三年，却从来都不明白你是一个怎样的人。
就像你的名字，我本来叫你提拉斯的，希望你能跟雄鹰一样强大，并且用这个名字叫了你两年，结果，你两岁的时候就告诉我，你叫云初。”
塞来玛语音低沉，眼角含着泪，瞅着云初的目光中满是不舍。
“云初不是塞人的名字，更不是回纥人的名字。
我问过老羊皮了，他说，这个名字是唐人的名字，他还说因为我是你的母亲，所以你会杀死跟我睡觉的男人。
羯斯噶六年前就希望我进入他的帐篷，我也想进入他的帐篷，因为担心你杀死羯斯噶，这才拖延到了今天。”
云初笑道： “既然你喜欢羯斯噶，他对你又那么好，我没有理由杀死他。
再说了，那个时候我才七岁，怎么能杀得了羯斯噶这种武士呢？”

塞来玛叹口气道： “你一直觉得塞人，回纥人都是傻子，我虽然也傻了一些，毕竟是养育了你的母亲，你的一举一动都在我的眼皮子底下，就算再傻，也能看出来一些别人看不到的东西。
你八岁的时候给萨拉本的马喂了一些红石头泡的水，那匹马没过几天就死了，就因为萨拉本喝醉了打我。
你九岁的时候给挥食狞喝的水里加了一些绿色的树叶汁水，挥食狞当天就上吐下泻。
就这样，你还不放过他，继续把那种添加了蜜糖的水让他的儿子喂给他喝，整整喝了六天。
让一个好好的武士，倒在自己的粪便堆里差一点死去，也让一个强壮的武士变得跟烂泥一样，谁都能过去欺负他一下。
你这么做，就是因为挥食狞在你脸上吐口水？
还有，上一任大阿波米思拉看你长得好看，调笑着说要把你献给可汗当娈童，一定能获得可汗的喜爱。
结果，第二天，他就骑着马从矮人坡的悬崖上跳下去了，找到他的时候，人跟马都摔成了肉泥。
现在，又是葛萨路父子的死……
云初，我有些害怕你了。
老羊皮总是说你是属于他的，你准备去找他了吗？”
云初放下手中吃了一半的鱼笑嘻嘻的对塞来玛道： “我是你的儿子，不是魔鬼，更不是魔鬼的儿子。
你说的这些事情跟我一点关系都没有。
你不用害怕我，等羯斯噶谋划的事情结束了，我就会离开，你只需要你会在这个戈壁上听到关于我的传说，就像你经常唱的歌谣里的那些英雄一样，我的名字也会被所有人传唱的。”
塞来玛的一番话让云初多少有些伤心。
他做的事情远比塞来玛知道的多得多。
一个成熟的美丽的女人，在白羊部这个弥漫着浓烈的男性荷尔蒙气息的部族里想要过上自己想要的日子天知道有多难。
白羊部的男人们都喜欢塞来玛，真正愿意靠近塞来玛，能跟她相爱的人只有羯斯噶。
羯斯噶是真的很喜欢塞来玛，为了塞来玛他甚至可以
不要自己的生命。

把塞来玛看的比生命还重要，这不是羯斯噶口头上的说辞，而是实实在在的行动。
因为自从云初发现羯斯噶跟塞来玛两人总喜欢钻草丛之后，羯斯噶经历的所有苦难都跟云初有关，其中最凶险的一次就是在他们办事的时候，身边出现了一匹叫做老王的孤狼。
那一次羯斯噶的表现很好，尽管屁股上被那匹叫做老王的狼咬了一口，他还是奋力的与狼周旋掩护塞来玛快跑，最后勇敢的光着屁股打跑了那只叫做老王的孤狼。
还有一次，是年幼的娜哈被一群旱獭围攻……羯斯噶跑的比马还要快的去拯救娜哈，那一次，羯斯噶真的跑的比马还要快，这不是形容词。
通过种种试探，羯斯噶获得了云初的认可，这个男人配的上塞来玛，也配当娜哈的父亲。
塞来玛不知道云初为了他，不辞辛劳的在天山脚下找到了草乌，找到了汞矿石，找到了可以麻痹神经的曼陀罗，草本曼陀罗里面的东莨菪碱含量太少，他又不得不进行提纯，结果，工具不全，失败了。
而羯斯噶在很长时间内，都是云初试药的对象，这就导致羯斯噶一生艰难，身上有时候会长泡，有时候会溃烂，有时候会呼吸困难。
这样做非常的恶毒，也非常的不合适，但是呢，云初认为是合适的，只有经历了这么多磨难娶到塞来玛，羯斯噶才会珍惜。
这也是没有办法的事情，一个成熟的二十八岁的青年，在一个繁华的社会里刚刚要被重用，就被时光突兀的带去了一个他完全陌生的世界。
如果是仅仅是这样，云初并不缺少从头再来的勇气，只是，当他发现自己变成一个只会啼哭的婴儿的时候，那种剧烈的反差，彻底的改变了他原本的人格。
漫长的婴儿时光，让他只能进行漫长的思考，漫长的等待。
如此漫长的时光，没有给让他学会仁爱，只是让他从一个婴儿角度看够了这个世界的丑恶。
content_en:
Because the Cypriot tribe is timid, they have always liked to be stationed close to the Uighur king's tent. Therefore, when there are foreign enemies, the Cypriot tribe feels very safe. If there is a mole, the Cypriot tribe will be unlucky.
Jiesika is one of the few smart people in this ethnic group. When faced with such a big change, he still knows how to come over and hint. It seems that he really loves Selema and Naha.
It was also the first time that Yunchu discovered among the Uighur tribe that there were men who valued a woman's life and death more important than his own life.
You know, once Bizogdiqin finds out that he has leaked his plan, his fate will be very miserable, and beheading is the lightest fate in the face of this kind of fate.
Because Jiesga's life was at stake, Yunchu had to be very careful. He prepared all the tools for catching marmots, and took a happy Naha and a helpless Selema to Grasshopper Lake.
From beginning to end, he never told Selema why he took their mother and daughter to Grasshopper Lake at a time that was not suitable for catching marmots.
Before dark, the three of them arrived at Grasshopper Lake. It was only more than a thousand meters away from the tribal camp, and the terrain was still high. If something happened tonight, the three of them should be able to see it.
Selema knew something was wrong when she saw that Yunchu did not set up the rope net to catch the marmots, but started to build a simple house on the edge of the rock.
I wanted to ask Yun Chu, but when I thought that Yun Chu was the owner of this house, I shut my mouth and picked up dead branches around with Naha to prepare for fire at night.
The place where Yunchu built his house was well chosen. It was between three huge rocks. As long as some branches were added on top, the firelight could be well covered up.
After building the house, Yunchu took a wooden fork to the lake.
Uighur people don’t eat fish!
They don’t eat fish not because they have any taboos, but because they simply don’t know how to handle fish!
There were many fish in Grasshopper Lake, and they were not afraid of people at all, so Yun Chu easily caught a fish with a wooden fork.
The temperature of the lake water here is relatively cold, and there is a kind of cold-water flat-mouthed fish that can easily grow up to ten pounds. In Grasshopper Lake, the big fish are very ferocious and like to eat small fish. Therefore, the small fish hid in the shallow water to avoid the big fish, which happened to be advantageous for Yunchu, Selema and Naha.
The three of them are probably the only ones in the entire Uighur tribe who know how to eat fish and how to cook it.
Naha's ability to grow so fat at such a young age has a lot to do with eating this kind of fish.
The flatmouth fish is a kind of fine-scaled fish found in cold lakes in the mountains. Use a knife to make an opening, remove the internal organs and gills, pinch the skin and tear it hard to peel off the whole fish skin. Find a wooden stick to skewer it, sprinkle with salt, and put it aside to marinate.
After an old wolf with mottled fur patrolled the lake for a while, he naturally came to lie down beside Yun Chu and their fire, looking at the busy Yun Chu with his tawny eyes, like an old dog.
"Old Wang!" Naha cheered and rushed to the old wolf. She rode her fat body on the old wolf's back, pinched the old wolf's ears and butt, and made him ride like a horse.
The old wolf opened its mouth wide and kept pretending to bite Naha, but Naha was not afraid at all and even put her hand into the wolf's mouth to grab the other person's tongue.
Selema was not worried at all and was busy laying sheepskins in the small house. Yunchu even ignored this man and wolf and was busy peeling fish skins.
If it weren't for Yun Chu's dislike of being too lonely and bored while herding sheep, this old lone wolf who was driven out by the wolf pack would have died long ago.
It was because of this old wolf that Yun Chu took Selema and Naha to leave the tribe camp at night and camp by Grasshopper Lake.
Yunchu has many good friends in Tianshan, but these good friends are all wild beasts. There is nothing he can do about it. The longer he spends time with the Huihe people, the more he likes to hang out with wild beasts.friend.
He has marmot friends, wolf friends, sheep friends, and even an old horse that is almost unable to walk, but he has no Uighur friends.
After the old wolf finished eating the fish skin with fish scales, he turned his attention to the sizzling grilled fish roasted by the campfire.
There are a lot of fish bones in the flat-mouthed fish. Yunchu has been peeling the fish for Naha to eat. She eats it very deliciously and is very greedy, but Selema seems to have no appetite, and she bites the fish one bite at a time.
"Nothing should happen to Jasika."
After Yunchu fed Naha, he also took a fish and ate it slowly.
Selema avoided Yunchu's gaze, looked at Naha who continued to play with the old wolf, and said: "You have never been from Sai, let alone from Uighur. You are different from all of us. Yunchu, you are from Tang Dynasty.
Only people in the Tang Dynasty have so many rules, and only people in the Tang Dynasty will truly regard me, the woman who raised you, as a mother.
Although I have raised you for thirteen years, I have never understood what kind of person you are.
Just like your name, I originally called you Tiras, hoping that you would be as powerful as the eagle, and I called you this name for two years. As a result, when you were two years old, you told me that your name was Yunchu. "
Selema's voice was low, with tears in her eyes, and she looked at Yun Chu with a look full of reluctance.
"Yunchu is not the name of a Sai person, let alone a Uighur person.
I asked Lao Yangpi, and he said that the name is a Tang Dynasty name. He also said that because I am your mother, you will kill the man who sleeps with me.
Jiesika wanted me to enter his tent six years ago, and I also wanted to enter his tent. I was worried that you would kill Jiesika, so I delayed it until today. "
Yun Chu smiled and said: "Since you like Jiesga and he is so kind to you, I have no reason to kill him.
Besides, I was only seven years old at that time, how could I kill a warrior like Jiesika? "
Selema sighed and said: "You always think that Sai people and Uighurs are fools. Although I am a little bit stupid, after all, I am the mother who raised you. Your every move is under my nose. No matter how stupid you are, you can still see some things that others cannot.
When you were eight years old, you fed Saraben's horse some water soaked in red stones. The horse died within a few days because Saraben was drunk and beat me.
When you were nine years old, you added some green leaf juice to the water that Hui Shihui drank. Hui Shihui suffered from vomiting and diarrhea that day.
Just like that, you didn't let him go and continued to feed his son the water with honey added for six days.
Let a good samurai fall in a pile of his own feces and almost die, and let a strong samurai become like mud. Anyone can bully him.
Are you doing this just because the beast spits in your face?
Also, the previous Great Apomithra saw that you were good-looking and teased you and said that he would offer you to the Khan as a prostitute, and you would definitely gain the Khan's love.
As a result, the next day, he rode his horse and jumped off the cliff of Dwarf Slope. When they found him, both the man and the horse were reduced to a pulp.
Now, it’s the deaths of Gesalu and his son again…
Yunchu, I'm a little afraid of you.
Lao Yangpi always says that you belong to him. Are you ready to find him? "
Yunchu put down the half-eaten fish in his hand and said to Selema with a smile: "I am your son, not the devil, nor the devil's son.
The things you mentioned have nothing to do with me.
You don’t need to be afraid of me. I will leave when Jiesga’s plan is over. All you need is that you will hear legends about me in this Gobi. Just like the heroes in the songs you often sing, my name will be sung by everyone. "
Selema's words made Yunchu somewhat sad.
He did far more than Selema knew.
a mature beautiful woman, God knows how difficult it is to live the life you want in the Aries tribe, a tribe filled with strong male hormones.
All the men in the Aries tribe like Selema, and the only one who is really willing to get close to Selema and can fall in love with her is Jiesika.
Jiesika really likes Selema, and he would even do it for Selema
Don't take your own life.
Treating Selema as more important than life is not just a rhetorical statement by Jasika, but a real action.
Because since Yunchu discovered that Jiesika and Selema always like to hide in the grass, all the hardships Jiesika has experienced are related to Yunchu. The most dangerous one was when they were doing things, and a lone wolf named Lao Wang appeared next to them.
Jiesika performed very well that time. Even though he was bitten by the wolf named Lao Wang on the buttocks, he still struggled with the wolf to cover Selema's run, and finally bravely beat away the lone wolf named Lao Wang with his bare buttocks.
Another time, the young Naha was besieged by a group of marmots...Jesga ran faster than a horse to save Naha. That time, Jiesga really ran faster than a horse. This is not an adjective.
After various trials, Jiesiga gained Yunchu's recognition. This man was worthy of Selema and Naha's father.
Selema didn't know that Yunchu worked tirelessly for him to find Caowu, mercury ore, and datura that can numb nerves at the foot of Tianshan Mountain. The content of scopolamine in the herb datura was too small, so he had to purify it. As a result, the tools were incomplete and he failed.
And Jiesika was the subject of Yunchu's drug test for a long time, which made Jiesika's life difficult. Sometimes he would get blisters on his body, sometimes it would fester, and sometimes he would have difficulty breathing.
This was very vicious and inappropriate, but Yunchu thought it was appropriate. Only after going through so many hardships to marry Selema would Jiesika cherish her.
There was nothing that could be done about it. A mature twenty-eight-year-old young man, just about to be reused in a prosperous society, was suddenly taken away by time to a world that was completely unfamiliar to him.
If it was just like this, Yun Chu did not lack the courage to start over again. However, when he found that he had turned into a crying baby, the sharp contrast completely changed his original personality.
The long period of infancy left him with nothing but long periods of thinking and long waiting.
Such a long time did not teach him kindness, but only allowed him to see enough of the ugliness of the world from a baby's perspective.
